subject: Renewal / Expansion: volume step-ups, blended rates, adding new routes/models
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia@stellarretail.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (volume / pricing follow-up)

Hi Lydia / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + action items so we have alignment heading into renewal discussions: 

TL;DR: Stellar is planning to 2–3x monthly token consumption over the next 12 months driven by two new routes (chat support -> LLM-assisted replies + product search reranking). You mentioned a target budget equivalent to roughly $18k–$22k / month for inference across those routes, and a target blended unit of ~$800–$1,000 per 1M tokens for the new work (after discounts).

Key notes from discovery:
- Current monthly active token baseline across existing routes: ~6.5M tokens/month (see attached Q3 usage CSV).
- New routes estimate: chat support ~10M tokens/month, product rerank ~4M tokens/month in steady-state -> incremental ~14M tokens/month.
- Renewal window: contract renewal in Jan 2027; you want pricing options now to evaluate internal budget for Nov/Dec planning.

What Redwood will do next:
1) Share a pricing sketch with volume step-ups and blended-rate scenarios (attached initial proposal PDF). This will include per-route recommended defaults for batching & caching to hit target $/1M tokens.
2) Outline unit economics assumptions (average seq length, effective batching factor, expected cache hit).
3) If the sketch looks good, we’ll schedule a 30-minute pricing alignment call next week (propose Wed 11/17 or Thu 11/18).

Requested from your side:
- Confirm the 14M incremental token estimate (or provide adjustments)
- Any internal constraints on discounting or procurement timeline we should know about

Attachments: stellar_usage_report_q3.csv, redwood_proposal_v3.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the pricing sketch by EOD 11/16.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0132
From: Lydia Chen <lydia@stellarretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stellarretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T14:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (volume / pricing follow-up)

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- The incremental estimate is directionally right. For budgeting we expect a conservative ramp: month 1: +6M, month 3: +10M, month 6+: +14M. So providing both step-up tiers and steady-state helps our CFO planning.
- Target blended unit: we are evaluating target $/1M tokens between $900–$1,050 post-discount depending on route SLAs. Lower for background rerank route, higher for low-latency chat.
- Procurement: our procurement lead prefers to see 12-month committed pricing with step-up bands; any discounts beyond standard tiering require Sales + Finance sign-off.

Would appreciate the sketch with explicit blended-rate math (how you get $/1M tokens) and the model assumptions (seq length, batch factor). Wed 11/17 at 10am PT works for a short call if you can do it.

—Lydia
Head of AI Products | Stellar Retail
lydia@stellarretail.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia@stellarretail.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T18:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (volume / pricing follow-up)

Lydia — thanks, confirmed on the ramp. Attached is the initial pricing sketch (redwood_proposal_v3.pdf). Below is the quick blended-rate math and assumptions so you have it in the email thread. If you want the full model sheet I can share a live Drive copy.

Blended-rate sketch (illustrative):
- Assumptions (steady-state): average token length per request: chat = 850 tokens, rerank = 120 tokens; effective batching factor: 2.2x for chat (due to concurrency), 1.3x for rerank; cache hit (prefix/KV) effective reduction: 8% chat, 0% rerank.
- Redwood list unit (baseline): $1,200 per 1M tokens for the models you’re using (open-compat, quantized).

Scenario A — 12-month committed, step-up bands, per-route blended:
- Band 1 (0–10M incremental): list $1,200 -> negotiated $1,050/1M
- Band 2 (10–25M incremental): list $1,200 -> negotiated $900/1M
- Band 3 (25M+ incremental): list $1,200 -> negotiated $700/1M

Estimated blended for your mix (steady-state +14M incremental): ~ $930/1M tokens (weighted across chat + rerank). That aligns with your target window.

Unit economics notes: with the expected batching and quantization profile we model an effective cost to Redwood of ~$220/1M tokens (GPU amortized + infra) at Band 2 volumes, leaving gross margin to support discounts, SLOs, and priority capacity.

Next steps:
- If this looks directionally right, we’ll prepare a formal term sheet with explicit step-up bands, blended pricing table by month, and a draft SOW for the new routes.
- Proposed call: Wed 11/17 at 10:00 AM PT — I’ve tentatively booked 30 minutes. Confirm or suggest alternate.

Also looping Neha from pricing/legal (cc) to flag any procurement constraints.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Chen <lydia@stellarretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (volume / pricing follow-up)

Quick internal note — I reviewed the sketch and the Band 2 blended of $900/1M looks acceptable from a margin + capacity standpoint for a 12-month committed renewal at ~14M incremental steady-state. Approve moving forward with a term sheet that includes: 
- Banded step-ups as outlined (1,050 / 900 / 700)
- 30% of incremental capacity reserved for priority routing during peak (adds to cost assumptions)
- Standard enterprise SLA and an option for a demo of Dedicated pools if they want stricter latency guarantees.

Neha — please prepare a short procurement note on the minimum legal terms we need (data residency, audit logs, KMS language) so we can include it in the draft.

Marissa — you have my green light to present the term sheet and lock a follow-up commercial call with their procurement. 

-Rishi
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
